description: Committed HF golden-gate cases for MoE paths (PegaInfer-style). Accuracy gate, not thruput.
notes: ignore_eos=true keeps fixed max_new for token-length compare.
require_exact=true: --require-exact fails the gate if this case mismatches.
FORCE_HF must be all_token_text_exact for require_exact cases.
radix_native is report-only by default (FI/fused may first_diff).
dump-hf must load single-device + experts_implementation=batched_mm (match lite).
